description: nf-core/createpanelrefs samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 1.1.0 schema. Builds panels of normals from many normal alignments: a GATK Mutect2 panel of normals and a CNVkit copy-number reference.

tools.help: comma list of panels to build: mutect2 (a Mutect2 somatic panel of normals, for sarek's pon) and cnvkit (a CNVkit pooled reference). Not offered: germlinecnvcaller (needs gcnv_ploidy_priors, a contig-ploidy priors table that is not staged) and gens (a reference for the GENS viewer, which NExtSEEK does not use).

mutect2_target_bed.help: exome or capture only: the kit's target BED as a path on the cluster; Mutect2 calls each normal only inside it. Unset on whole-genome normals.

mutect2_intervals_num.help: how many interval chunks Mutect2 and GenomicsDBImport are scattered over.

mutect2_pon_name.help: file name stem of the panel of normals VCF (gatk4/createsomaticpanelofnormals/<name>.vcf.gz).

cnvkit_method.help: wgs for whole-genome normals, hybrid for exome or hybrid capture, amplicon for amplicon panels; hybrid and amplicon need cnvkit_targets. Must match how the tumours to be compared were sequenced.

cnvkit_targets.help: with cnvkit_method hybrid or amplicon: the kit's target BED as a path on the cluster.

cnvkit_pon_name.help: file name stem of the CNVkit reference (cnvkit/<name>.cnn).

pipeline.name: nf-core/createpanelrefs
pipeline.core_rule: One row per normal sample: sample, then bam and bai for a BAM, or cram and crai for a CRAM. Every row is a normal: the pipeline treats every sample as one of the panel. The index columns may be blank (the pipeline indexes a file without one).
pipeline.reference_requirement: The FASTA the alignments were made against, with its .fai and .dict. Mutect2 refuses reads whose contigs do not match the reference.

validation_rules: The file is CSV with header sample,bam,bai for BAM normals, sample,cram,crai for CRAM normals, or sample,bam,bai,cram,crai when the cohort mixes them (each row then leaves the other pair blank).
Each row needs exactly one of bam (ending .bam) or cram (ending .cram) (assets/schema_input.json oneOf); the file must exist when the run starts.
Only normal samples (blood or normal tissue): a tumour in the panel removes its own somatic mutations from every later call. Leave tumours out, and ask when a sample's normal status is unclear.
Every alignment must be against one reference, and the run's FASTA must be that reference: GDC/TCGA BAMs are aligned to GDC's GRCh38.d1.vd1, which is not the staged GATK GRCh38 bundle.
A panel of normals is meant for tumours sequenced the same way: whole-genome normals for whole-genome tumours, the same capture kit (mutect2_target_bed, cnvkit_targets) for exomes.
Do not request germlinecnvcaller (its ploidy priors are not staged) or gens.
notes: Input is alignments (samplesheet_input_kind bam): D.SEQ leaves whose registered data file is a BAM or CRAM on the cluster. A FASTQ cohort must be aligned first. Mutect2's per-normal calls run in tumour-only mode. The Mutect2 PoN mirrors GATK's: no germline resource is passed (1.1.0 declares none).

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/createpanelrefs input samplesheet.

bam.validation_hints: Absolute cluster path from the sample's Link_PrimaryData / File_PrimaryData.

bai.validation_hints: Blank when none is registered; the pipeline indexes it.

cram.validation_hints: Only for CRAM rows; its reference must be the run's FASTA.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/createpanelrefs samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort of normal-sample alignments.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected to build a panel of normals (Mutect2, CNVkit) from many normals. For variant calls of these samples use sarek; it can later use the Mutect2 panel.
report_writer_guidance.output_expectation: CSV with header sample,bam,bai (or the CRAM form).
population_priority: One row per normal D.SEQ; sample = the D.SEQ UID; bam/bai (or cram/crai) from its registered data file.
Leave out any tumour; ask when a sample's normal status is unclear.
Name the reference the alignments were made against; say so when it is not the staged bundle.
final_checks: Every row has exactly one of bam or cram, ending in .bam or .cram.
No tumour sample is in the sheet.
For capture normals, mutect2_target_bed (and cnvkit_targets with cnvkit_method hybrid) name the kit's BED.

runtime.basis: First guess for one 16-CPU Luria node; not measured. Mutect2 runs once per normal, then one GenomicsDBImport and CreateSomaticPanelOfNormals over all of them.
